Class TreeGrid

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.control.Control
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.Grid
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.TreeGrid
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget, javafx.scene.control.Skinnable
public final class TreeGrid extends Grid

A Grid for a TreeGridModel: the first model column shows each item indented by its depth, with a triangle that expands and collapses it. Click the triangle to expand or collapse; a double click does the same unless the grid has a cell action or is editable. On the keyboard, Right and + expand, Left and - collapse, Left on a collapsed item goes to its parent, and Right on an expanded one in row selection goes to its first child. Expanding widens the tree column for wider children unless it has an explicit width. Sorting sorts children among their siblings. The extra style class is tree-grid.

The first column keeps its renderer and gets the indentation and the triangle in front of it. Another model than a TreeGridModel is shown like in any grid. A row filter tests each row on its own: a child that passes stays visible when its parent does not.
